title: sieve-daemon: unit tests for filter handler and script cache
description:
Test suite for the sieve-daemon filter handler, independent of the client code.

What: crates/sieve-daemon/tests/filter_tests.rs (or inline mod tests in filter.rs)

Tests (oracle: run same scripts through usenet_ipfs_sieve::evaluate directly in the test):
1. fileinto_routes_to_folder: script 'fileinto "INBOX.work";' → action FileInto(folder=INBOX.work)
2. reject_returns_reason: script 'reject "no spam";' → action Reject(reason=no spam)
3. discard_action: script 'discard;' → action Discard
4. implicit_keep: script with condition that never matches → action Keep
5. compile_error_returns_422: send invalid sieve syntax → HTTP 422 response
6. cache_hit_skips_recompile: send same script twice; inject spy counter into cache; assert compile called once
7. check_endpoint_valid: POST /check with valid script → 200
8. check_endpoint_invalid: POST /check with bad syntax → 422 + error string

Each test spins up a live Axum server on a temp Unix socket path (use tempfile::TempDir for cleanup).
Oracle: expected action is derived by running the same script through usenet_ipfs_sieve::evaluate() in the test itself — both paths (direct and via HTTP) must agree.
